categories.name: Café Sandwiches
categories.intro: The café sandwich board is where Au Bon Pain feels most like a neighborhood lunch counter: familiar fillings, soft bread, and enough texture to make a desk lunch feel considered. We like these chilled options when you want something quick without a heavy finish. Pair chicken salad with iced tea, or tuna with a bright fruit cup. Recipes, ingredients, and availability can vary by café, so use this guide as a starting point and confirm details at the counter.
faqs: Can I find ingredients before ordering?

categories.name: Signature Hot Sandwiches
categories.intro: These are the warm, melty choices for a lunch that deserves a little more attention. Expect toasted bread, savory fillings, and contrasting cool elements such as avocado. We reach for the Newport Turkey when we want classic comfort, while the Chipotle Black Bean & Avocado brings a satisfying meat-free option with a gentle kick. Ask your café what can be toasted and whether a listed special is still available.
faqs: What pairs well with a toasted sandwich?

categories.name: Wraps
categories.intro: Wraps are tidy, portable, and especially useful when lunch has to travel. Chicken Caesar leans savory and familiar; Mediterranean gives vegetarians a fresh, herb-forward choice; Napa Chicken with Avocado is creamy and crisp at once. A side salad or fruit keeps the meal balanced without making it fussy. Café assembly and availability differ, so check the ingredient list when allergies matter.

categories.name: Hot or Cold Sandwiches
categories.intro: This group gives you a little control over the mood of your meal. Turkey Club and Ham & Two Cheese are easy, dependable picks; Caprese brings tomato, cheese, and a lighter Italian feel; Chipotle Turkey & Avocado adds smoky heat. Choose toasted when you want crisp edges and melted cheese, or cold when you are saving lunch for later. Always confirm the current build at your café.
faqs: Which sandwiches can be served hot or cold?
What is a good lighter pairing?

categories.name: Soups
categories.intro: A warm cup of soup can turn a simple sandwich into a proper café lunch. Au Bon Pain’s soup lineup ranges from creamy Broccoli Cheddar and Tomato Basil Bisque to brothy Chicken Noodle and hearty Turkey Chili. Garden Vegetable is the obvious meat-free bowl, while Macaroni & Cheese is pure comfort. Soup rotation is one of the things most likely to vary by location and season, so check the day’s board before making the trip.
faqs: Are all soups available every day?

categories.name: Seasonal
categories.intro: Seasonal items are the reason a familiar café can still surprise you. Limited-time releases and returning favorites may appear for a short window, so we label them clearly rather than pretending they are always available. Everything Avocado Toast makes a bright breakfast or snack; Marble Pound Cake is a simple sweet finish. Look for the Limited Time badge and verify dates with the café before planning around one item.
faqs: How often do seasonal items change?
Can I check seasonal availability online?

categories.name: Breakfast
categories.intro: The breakfast menu covers both grab-and-go mornings and slower coffee breaks. Egg and cheese sandwiches are familiar and easy to carry, while The Good Egg and the Power Protein Wrap make a more substantial start. Classic Oatmeal is a warm vegetarian choice when you want something spoonable. We pair savory breakfast items with coffee and save a pastry for later; your café’s breakfast hours may be different from its posted lunch hours.
faqs: What is a good breakfast on the go?
Does breakfast end at the same time everywhere?

categories.name: Salads
categories.intro: Salads are useful when you want the café experience without a toasted roll. Chicken Cobb Avocado is rich and filling, Southwest Chicken brings a little brightness, and Mediterranean keeps things fresh and meat-free. Chicken Caesar Asiago is the familiar favorite. Dressings make a meaningful difference, so ask for them on the side if you prefer to control the finish. Ingredients and add-ons should be confirmed with the café.
faqs: Can dressing come on the side?

categories.name: Bakery
categories.intro: The bakery case is where Au Bon Pain earns its name: breads, croissants, bagels, muffins, cookies, danishes, scones, brownies, pound cakes, and cinnamon swirl rolls invite a little browsing. We like a plain bagel with coffee early, a scone for a midmorning pause, and a cookie when lunch needs a sweet punctuation mark. Bakes can sell out and the selection varies by café, so the display in front of you is the final word.
faqs: What is included in the bakery selection?
Are bakery items available all day?
Can I order bread for a group?

categories.name: Bon to Go & Snacks
categories.intro: Bon to Go makes the café useful between meals. Boxed combinations such as Fruit Egg & Nuts, Cheese & Fruit, and Hummus are easy to pack, while scoops, yogurt parfaits, fruit, grapes, nuts, and hard-boiled eggs let you build a smaller snack. Signature Granola and chocolate covered almonds are good desk-drawer candidates. Treat these as convenient options, not promises of specific nutrition; packaging and availability should be checked before purchase.
faqs: Do snack items vary by location?

categories.name: Beverages
categories.intro: From a straightforward hot coffee to espresso, tea, iced coffee, iced tea, cold beverages, and smoothies, the drink menu can carry the whole visit. Berry Pomegranate, Mango, and Strawberry smoothies suit a fruit-forward break; hot tea is a quieter pairing for soup. Sizes, dairy choices, sweeteners, and availability vary, and we do not publish guessed calories. Use the official nutrition guide for the most current information.
